solves.reasoning: (A) numerous ways wildlife is managed=많은 방법=numerous. (B) actively managed by ___ the habitat=바꿈=altering. (C) minimize ___ influences on populations=외부=external. numerous—altering—external.
(A) two ___ categories=넓은=broad. (B) numbers too ___ → predator control to minimize deaths=적음=low. (C) provide ___ cover for neonates=필요한=required. broad—low—required.
(A) in a ___ manner through translocations/hunting=직접적=direct. (B) to the ___ or disadvantage=이익=benefit. (C) management can be ___=도입되다=incorporated. direct—benefit—incorporated.
④ maximize가 '외부 영향을 최소화한다'는 비활동적 관리 흐름과 모순. 원래 minimize여야 함. stewardship/decreasing/habitat는 적절.
① high가 '개체수가 적을 때 포식자 통제로 새끼를 보호한다'와 모순. 원래 low여야 함. required/external/animals는 적절.
③ internal이 'minimize external influences'와 모순. 원래 external여야 함. numerous/direct/animals는 적절.
classified into two broad ___: active and inactive management 두 종류가 이어짐 → categories.
through ___ like translocations or hunting=이주/사냥 같은 방법 → strategies.
minimize external ___ on populations and habitat=외부 영향 → influences.
numerous=수많은 → many.
altering the habitat=바꾸다 → changing.
management can be incorporated=포함/도입되다 → included.
minimize=최소화 반대 → maximize. reduce/lower는 동의어 함정, avoid는 무관.
broad=넓은 반대 → narrow. wide/vast는 동의어 함정, sharp는 무관.
(A) good cover from predators=은신처(명사), (B) cover the pot with a lid=덮다(동사).
맡겨진 것을 책임감 있게 관리하는 것 정의 → stewardship. 본문 imply stewardship.
Populations can also be actively ___ (manage): 수동태 be+과거분사 → managed.
such as ___ (increase) or decreasing: 뒤 decreasing과 병렬 -ing → increasing.
involves ___ and not animals: 동물이 아니라 사람 관리 → management of humans.
In such situations, management activities ___: 국립공원처럼 비활동적 관리는 외부 영향 최소화 → minimize external influences on populations and habitat.
